57/G.goal: Explain how the VR 3D viewing pipeline prepares a 3D scene for display and identify where its transformations and geometry removal support VR resource optimization.
57/G.achieves: Equips the learner to reason about graphics resource usage before studying optimization techniques and to understand and implement XR systems with confidence.

57/O1.goal: Describe how the VR 3D viewing pipeline transforms world geometry into device display coordinates and removes unnecessary geometry before rendering.
57/O1.achieves: Provides the learner with a model of the graphics pipeline stages that affect rendering workload, which is needed to understand resource requirements and optimization in XR systems.
